hooks.name: exorcist-gate
hooks.description: When the agent finishes its turn, check the agent-facing files it changed (steering, specs, hooks, agents, MCP configs, AGENTS.md, READMEs) against the last commit. If the change adds a high or critical finding, exit 1: Kiro sends the stderr list to the agent, which has to remove the change or tell the user. Read-only, no network. Runs through scripts/kiro-hook.sh because Kiro gives hook commands a PATH without Node.
